sectionTitle: Morality, Hiddenness, and the Evidential Force of Evil

lockedMove.speaker: William Lane Craig
lockedMove.excerpt: true but the problem is that premise 2 objective moral values do exist in moral experience we apprehend a realm of objective moral values that impose themselves upon us there's no more reason to deny the objective morality or objective uh objective reality of moral values than the objective reality of the physical world actions like rape cruelty and child abuse aren't just socially unacceptable Behavior they moral Abominations Michael Roose himself admits and I quote the man who says it is morally acceptable to rape little children is just as mistaken as the man who says 2 + 2 equal 5 some things are really wrong similarly love
lockedMove.proposition: Objective moral values are apprehended as real and binding, and their existence entails that God exists.
